claim.text: Explicit sweep derivations cover L17's two nonzero residues and all one-tail inputs C(x,b).(01)^c1^r at x>=7,c>=1,b in {0,1,2}; some inputs create another tail layer. The supplied blank boundary has a bounded derived continuation.
claim.scope: Three contextual lemmas, six short cases, 4,333 rule endpoint checks, 300 random interpreter controls, 14 unittest methods, and a separate 2,000-rewrite arithmetic trace. No Lean theorem or complete stacked reduction.
assumptions: Exact two-symbol TM semantics with blank symbol 0 and the displayed literal transition table.
The incoming blank reachability to C(6575648756,1) is supplied by Claude, not independently inspected or built here.
Universal interpretation uses the mathematical sweep compositions and finite local paths; no proof assistant was run here.
The earlier census is a dated snapshot, not refreshed by this follow-up.
forbidden_promotions: No new certified cryptid, halting or non-halting theorem.
A second tail layer on an arbitrary input does not imply unbounded stack depth or blank reachability.
The derived huge-time trajectory is not raw simulation or a Lean certificate.
Two thousand successful rewrites do not prove reachable closure.

specification.intended_object: Whole-tape raw-machine endpoints, exact time/head counts, context-preserving local paths, one-tail shapes and an explicitly bounded arithmetic orbit.
invariants: Both tape exteriors are zero; the C head reads the first displayed symbol.
Only exterior trailing zeros may be omitted; interior zeros remain explicit.
Every endpoint includes complete nonzero support, state, head displacement and defined raw-transition count.
Unknown guards, absent dispatch cases and budget stops remain explicit.
known_answer_cases: Undefined F1 halts without writing, moving or increasing the transition count.
Each A01, D10 and C01 path reads only its own two-cell block.
Claude's C(x,1).T observation is F111 with c=7,v=1, giving time 4x+80.
C(7,1).(01)^8 1 reaches C(0,2).T.T in 152 transitions, shift -2.
